name: Lithuanian Academy of Music and Theatre
summary: National academy in Vilnius for music, theatre, film and dance; English teaching on its music and dance bachelor's, by audition.

ib.text: Entry is by audition and exams, not IB grades; you need a recognised secondary certificate and English at B1. EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO and can compete for state-funded places.

apply.via: LAMA BPO (EU citizens); email LMTA otherwise

lastYear.text: LAMA BPO; exams from mid-June, offers 30 July

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with piano as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Your principal instrument, the piano, is studied in every semester, supported by piano accompaniment, sight-reading, piano ensemble and chamber ensemble. Alongside it run ear training and music theory (or harmony, polyphony and analysis), the language of music from the Middle Ages to the twentieth century, the history of piano art and of Lithuanian music and culture. Professional practice builds experience, and the degree ends with a final art project, a piano accompaniment project and a chamber ensemble project, each defended in public.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with string instruments as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: The degree centres on a principal string instrument (violin, viola, cello, double bass, harp or guitar), studied through seven semesters. Orchestra life is built in through symphony orchestra and orchestral parts and sight-reading, and chamber music is compulsory, with a string quartet for violin, viola and cello players. Theory, ear training, music analysis, the history of string instruments and of Lithuanian music complete the core, followed by professional practice and a final art project plus a chamber ensemble project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with wind and percussion as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: You specialise in one wind or percussion instrument (flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, saxophone, horn, trumpet, trombone, tuba, baritone, euphonium, cornet or percussion), studied every semester. A large share of the study goes to ensemble and orchestra work: wind quintet, equal-voice or chamber ensembles, symphony, wind or brass band orchestras, and percussion ensembles. Basics of conducting, the history of wind instruments and percussion, theory and music history sit alongside, and professional practice leads to a final art project and an ensemble art project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with vocal performance as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Vocal performance is studied in every semester together with chamber vocal performance, the phonetics of foreign languages, Italian, stage speech, stage movement, acting and dance, plus piano as a secondary instrument. Theory, ear training, music history, the history of vocal art and of Lithuanian music complete the core. Stage experience comes through opera practice and professional practice, and the degree ends with an opera art project, a chamber singing art project and a final art project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with jazz as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: The principal instrument or voice (accordion, bass guitar, vocals, flute, piano, guitar, clarinet, double bass, percussion, saxophone, trumpet or trombone) is taught alongside jazz improvisation, jazz harmony and rhythmics, arranging, the basics of jazz composition and jazz history. You play in an ensemble and in a big band (vocalists sing in a jazz choir), and learn digital notation and sound recording equipment. A secondary instrument, professional practice, a final art project and an ensemble art project round it off.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with accordion as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Accordion is studied as the principal instrument across the degree, with chamber ensemble, accordion orchestra, basics of conducting and instrumentation. Core academic subjects include ear training and music theory, harmony, analysis, music history, the history of accordion art and of Lithuanian music and culture. Professional practice builds experience and the degree closes with a final art project and a chamber ensemble art project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with organ as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Organ is the principal instrument, joined by a sacred music studio (choir, Latin, sacred music history, choir conducting, liturgics and liturgy practice), basso continuo, improvisation, the structure and tuning of the organ, chamber ensemble and accompaniment, and a secondary choice of harpsichord, piano or voice. Theory, music history and the history of organ art and of Lithuanian music complete the study. Professional practice and a final art project plus a chamber ensemble and accompaniment project close the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with harpsichord as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: The harpsichord is studied for seven semesters, with a secondary instrument (piano or organ), chamber ensemble, the structure and tuning of the harpsichord, basso continuo and figured bass. Supporting subjects include ear training, harmony, polyphony and musical analysis, the history of harpsichord art, music history alternatives and the history of Lithuanian music and culture, with philosophy and aesthetics. Professional practice leads to a chamber ensemble art project and a defended final art project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with choir conducting as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Choir conducting is the main subject, together with choir score reading, choir singing, vocal performance, choral arrangement, choral conducting theory and piano for choir conductors. The history of Lithuanian and European choral music broadens the picture. Professional practice has two routes, conducting a children's choir or a church choir, the latter with organ, liturgy and Gregorian chant, and the degree ends with a final art project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with wind orchestra conducting as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Conducting is studied through seven semesters together with a wind instrument, wind orchestra playing, score reading, instrumentation and piano. Ear training, the language of music across the periods and Lithuanian music history provide the background. Practice is central: professional practice, a dedicated practice in conducting a wind orchestra, and a final art project at the end of the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: A performer's degree with symphony orchestra conducting as the main subject: preparing and performing works in many styles as a soloist or in ensembles, with music history and theory.
programmes.overview: Conducting is the main subject through all semesters, supported by score reading, instrumentation, piano, ear training and the language of music across the periods. Specialist subjects include the musical articulation of the string group in a symphony orchestra and orchestra music styles, and a symphony orchestra conducting practice runs over several semesters. Lithuanian music history, professional practice and a final art project complete the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Studies
programmes.about: Music professionals with music history, theory and technology skills who can start, create and assess music projects. Specialisation: composition.
programmes.overview: The composition specialisation combines individual lessons and practice in composing with a composition theory studio and seminars, orchestration, instruments and score, piano, ear training and conducting, and music technology literacy. Analysis and composing principles, contexts of music and sound, music history and Lithuanian music history sit alongside, plus electives such as music and performer management, project management, public relations and copyright. A practice of implementing art projects leads to a final bachelor's project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Studies
programmes.about: Music professionals with music history, theory and technology skills who can start, create and assess music projects. Specialisation: electronic music.
programmes.overview: The electronic music specialisation is built around individual lessons and practice in electronic music, an electronic music studio and ensemble, virtual instruments, arrangement and electronic music seminars, with music technology literacy and ear training and conducting. Analysis and composing principles, contexts of music and sound and music history frame the practice, with electives in music and performer management, project management, public relations and copyright. A practice of implementing art projects leads to a final bachelor's project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Music Studies
programmes.about: Music professionals with music history, theory and technology skills who can start, create and assess music projects. Specialisation: music and education.
programmes.overview: The music and education specialisation combines music (piano, ear training, musical computer technologies, analysis and composing principles, music history) with pedagogy: introduction to art pedagogy, pedagogical and developmental psychology, creative pedagogy, and methodology and practice in preschool, primary and secondary music education. Pedagogical practice and observation of modern education strategies put this into practice, and the study ends with a final thesis of pedagogical studies alongside the bachelor's project.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a specialisation exam, an admission interview and a musical knowledge test worth 10%; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Dance
programmes.about: Trains classical or contemporary dance specialists who know the context and development of dance art and can work professionally and creatively in cultural life. Specialisation: classical dance.
programmes.overview: The classical dance specialisation is organised around dance praxis and creation and dance theory and discourses through most of the degree, with voice and acting praxis, sound and space contexts, and professional sustainability and practice running throughout. Philosophy, aesthetics, project management and the psychology of art and creativity add the wider context, and the degree ends with a final art project that is defended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the specialisation entrance exam and an admission interview; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Dance admits every two years; the next intake is in 2027.

separateFrom.name: Dance and Education
separateFrom.reason: Different programme: dance and education trains dance teachers and group leaders in several styles; this one trains classical or contemporary dance artists.

programmes.name: Dance
programmes.about: Trains classical or contemporary dance specialists who know the context and development of dance art and can work professionally and creatively in cultural life. Specialisation: contemporary dance.
programmes.overview: The contemporary dance specialisation is organised around dance praxis and creation and dance theory and discourses through most of the degree, with voice and acting praxis, sound and space contexts, and professional sustainability and practice running throughout. Philosophy, aesthetics, project management and the psychology of art and creativity add the wider context, and the degree ends with a final art project that is defended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the specialisation entrance exam and an admission interview; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Dance admits every two years; the next intake is in 2027.

programmes.name: Dance and Education
programmes.about: Trains dance specialists who master methods of ballroom, folk and performative dance styles and the history and theory of dance, with intercultural and subject skills.
programmes.overview: Core study covers classical dance, a dance lab, dance composition and improvisation, the history of dance art, world dance, historical dance and costume, anatomy and injury prevention, anthropology of dance and dance management. You choose one of three styles: ballroom dance, folk dance (including song festival dance composition) or performative dance. A minor in pedagogy brings art pedagogy, psychology, subject teaching methodology and pedagogical practice, ending in a final project and a pedagogical thesis.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the specialisation entrance exam and an admission interview; EU citizens apply through LAMA BPO. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Dance
separateFrom.reason: Different programme: dance artists in classical or contemporary dance; this one is dance teaching and group leadership.

notes: The English bachelor's are music performance, music studies and dance; film, theatre and the folk music, musical research and recording specialisations are taught in Lithuanian only.
EU citizens apply in the same national system as Lithuanians and may win a state-funded place; without one, tuition is €9,184 a year for music or €5,676 for dance, with a first-semester discount.
Dance admits every two years and lists 2027 as the next intake.
